newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Metro Pacific rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Metro Pacific rated a buy.

text.p: Diversified company Metro Pacific Corp, a unit of Hong Kong's First Pacific Co Ltd, was rated a buy by Manila brokerage firm Asian Capital Equities Inc on Friday on expectations of good earnings this year.

In a research paper, Asian Capital analyst Leila Calderon said that potential sales of its land in Fort Bonifacio, a property at the edge of Manila's financial district of Makati, will help boost the holding firm's 1997 net profits.
Smart Communications Co Inc, the telecoms arm of Metro Pacific, is expected to account for almost half of Metro's recurring income this year, she said.
Subsidiaries in the banking, consumer product and packaging sector are also likely to contribute substantially to the company's bottomline, Asian Capital said.
"Metro may have not reached our 1996 forecast but we believe that it can attain our 1997 forecast," said Calderon.
Asian Capital said it expects the company to log 1.865 billion pesos in profits this year.

Asian Capital had predicted a 1.495 billion peso net income for Metro in 1996. Last week, the company reported a 843.9 million peso net profit, a 64 percent increase from the previous year's 513.3 million.
